title: My child has difficulties with spatial awareness. Can Occupational Therapy assist?
metaTitle: Improving Spatial Awareness with Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network aids children struggling with spatial awareness. Guiding them in understanding their body position and movement.
html: Certainly, spatial awareness is one of the key areas that Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network targets. Our expert therapists plan activities and exercises that are specifically designed to help your child better understand and control their body movement and position in space.
